title: 第9章 磅礴的天地灵气第10章 天穹幻剑
content_zh:
“这不可能！
秦浩这个废物，怎么可能一剑击败秦方少爷！”
“他不是一品武魂吗？怎么会这样？怎么会这样？”
人群中，秦仲和秦华面面相觑，满是不可思议之色。
半月前，他们二人得知秦浩有二十枚淬体丹，便故意找秦浩麻烦，结果被秦浩狠狠教训了一顿。
原以为今日秦浩必然被秦方蹂躏，他们二人也能趁机报仇雪恨。
可结果，竟然是秦方败了！
两人吓得连忙缩进人群中，生怕被秦浩看见。
众多秦家子弟也回过神来，一个个的脸上都满是震惊。
不少刚刚还在贬低秦浩的人，此刻更是眼中露出一抹畏惧。
这个世界本就如此，强者为尊，秦浩展现出来的实力，足以让他们敬畏！
……
秦家，少主府。
一阵爽朗大笑响起，秦云天哈哈笑道：“浩儿，你可是瞒得我好苦啊，害得我白白担心一场，不过，干得漂亮！
今日，秦高池的脸面算是彻底没了！”
秦浩轻笑一声，没打算隐瞒，道：“父亲，其实我此次在墨林山脉……”
话还没说完，秦云天摆了摆手，认真道：“你不用说！
记住，无论遇到什么奇遇，得到了什么，都无需告诉别人，哪怕是我。”
在秦云天看来，秦浩此次在墨林山脉必然是有所奇遇，否则的话，以一品武魂资质，想要修炼到淬体境四重，何其之难？
可怀璧其罪的道理，他必须告诉秦浩。

“父亲，我记住了。”
秦浩重重点头，随即沉吟道：“父亲，我还有一事想要你帮忙。”
“何事？”
秦云天脸上笑意不停。
“我想要一百枚淬体丹！”
秦浩顿了顿。
“多少？”
秦云天双眸一瞪。
整个秦家一年的产出，也才不过数百枚淬体丹。
秦浩一次性拿走一百枚，若是秦高池知晓，必然又是一番唇枪舌战！
没等秦浩说话，秦云天眼中闪过一抹厉色，沉声道：“没问题！
浩儿，今天下午，我会让刘卫把丹药给你送来。”
content_en:
"This is impossible!
How could Qin Hao, a loser like him, defeat Master Qin Fang with one sword! "
"Isn't he a first-grade martial spirit? How could this happen? How could this happen?"
In the crowd, Qin Zhong and Qin Hua looked at each other in disbelief.
Half a month ago, the two of them learned that Qin Hao had twenty body tempering pills, so they deliberately made trouble for Qin Hao, but Qin Hao gave him a severe lesson.
I thought that Qin Hao would be ravaged by Qin Fang today, and the two of them could take the opportunity to take revenge.
But in the end, Qin Fang was defeated!
The two of them were so frightened that they quickly retreated into the crowd for fear of being seen by Qin Hao.
Many Qin family disciples also came to their senses, with shock on their faces.
Many people who were belittling Qin Hao just now had a hint of fear in their eyes.
This world is like this, where the strong are respected, and the strength Qin Hao showed was enough to awe them!
…
The Qin family, the young master's mansion.
A burst of hearty laughter rang out, and Qin Yuntian laughed and said: "Hao'er, it was so hard for you to hide it from me, and it made me worry in vain, but you did a great job!
Today, Qin Gaochi's face is completely gone! "
Qin Hao chuckled lightly, not intending to hide it, and said: "Father, actually I am in the Molin Mountains this time..."
Before he finished speaking, Qin Yuntian waved his hand and said seriously: "You don't need to say it!
Remember, no matter what adventures you encounter or what you get, you don’t need to tell anyone else, not even me. "
In Qin Yuntian's opinion, Qin Hao must have had an adventure in the Molin Mountains this time. Otherwise, how difficult would it be for him to cultivate to the fourth level of the Body Tempering Realm with his first-grade martial soul qualifications?
But he must tell Qin Hao why he was guilty of holding a jade.
"Father, I remember."
Qin Hao nodded heavily, and then said in deep thought: "Father, I still have something I want you to help with."
"What's the matter?"
Qin Yuntian's face kept smiling.
"I want a hundred body tempering pills!"
Qin Hao paused.
"How much?"
Qin Yuntian's eyes widened.
The output of the entire Qin family in a year is only a few hundred body tempering pills.
Qin Hao took away a hundred pieces at once. If Qin Gaochi knew about it, there would be another quarrel!
Before Qin Hao could speak, Qin Yuntian's eyes flashed with a stern look, and he said in a deep voice: "No problem!
Haoer, I will ask Liu Wei to deliver the elixir to you this afternoon. "
